title: Muse Sleep-Onset EEG — EEG/EMG Foundation Challenge 2026, Track 03
description: This dataset contains 540 at-home, four-channel (TP9, AF7, AF8, TP10) EEG recordings from 203 participants, collected with Muse headbands at 128 Hz. It was prepared for Track 03 (Sleep onset) of the EEG/EMG Foundation Challenge 2026, where the task is to predict time remaining until the first N2 sleep epoch from EEG recorded up to the prediction time. Each recording carries a single N2-onset annotation, and the deposit includes a train/test split and signal-quality flags.
methods_description: Recordings were made at home by participants using a Muse S family headband with four dry EEG channels (TP9, AF7, AF8, TP10), stored at 128 Hz (downsampling from 256 Hz is a curator-supplied assumption). Each recording lasts about 6 to 30 minutes and ends 300 s after the annotated first N2 epoch. Data were exported to BrainVision format with pybv and organized according to EEG-BIDS.
